deficiencies.description: The rewrite converts the lecturer's deictic pointing gestures into a specific spatial description ('lies next to the outer surface of the uterus') that is not stated or verified in the text.
deficiencies.sourcePassage: You can see that the tumor is here. This is the outer surface of the uterus.
deficiencies.rewritePassage: The tumour lies next to the outer surface of the uterus
deficiencies.caseForHarm: A student may incorrectly learn that benign uterine fibroids characteristically lie next to the outer uterine surface rather than within the muscular wall.
deficiencies.caseAgainstHarm: The lecturer indicated the tumour and the outer surface together on an image, making proximity a natural and plausible reading of the slide being presented.

considerations.sourcePassage: So you can see again that this is actually circumspect and very separate from the surrounding stroma and the surrounding tissue.
considerations.reason: The replacement of 'circumspect' with 'circumscribed' corrects an obvious verbal slip or transcription error with the correct medical terminology, ensuring proper understanding.

considerations.sourcePassage: Again, here is the outer surface of the uterus, and you have the tumor here, but this tumor is now growing within the wall of the uterus
considerations.reason: The rewrite renders 'here is the outer surface of the uterus' as 'the outer surface of the uterus is seen' without inventing an unsourced spatial arrangement.
